summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.06/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.06 a gallon across Wisconsin as of October 6, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 14¢ lower than a week ago, 33¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.37 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.86) and the highest in Superior ($4.42).
